GIM-DOCKER-001.title: Container engine not ready
GIM-DOCKER-001.cause: Docker Desktop / Podman is not running or not on PATH.
GIM-DOCKER-001.fix: Start Docker Desktop, wait until green, then: gim doctor

GIM-COLIBRI-001.title: Colibri Linux ELF engine missing
GIM-COLIBRI-001.cause: Docker Colibri needs Linux binary deepseek_v4 in GIM_COLIBRI_ROOT, not Windows .exe only.
GIM-COLIBRI-001.fix: Install ELF deepseek_v4 into colibri root, OR: gim start --gguf PATH

GIM-COLIBRI-002.title: Colibri model path invalid
GIM-COLIBRI-002.cause: Safetensors model directory missing or incomplete.
GIM-COLIBRI-002.fix: Set GIM_LLM_MODEL or bootstrap with valid model path; gim doctor

GIM-COLIBRI-003.title: Colibri warming timeout
GIM-COLIBRI-003.cause: MoE weights + expert tier promote can exceed patience; often engine/disk issue.
GIM-COLIBRI-003.fix: Check colibri container logs; fix GIM-COLIBRI-001 first; use NVMe for model tree

GIM-LLM-001.title: LLM backend start failed
GIM-LLM-001.cause: LLM container or llama-server did not become healthy.
GIM-LLM-001.fix: gim diagnose --logs; gim stop --full-stop; gim start again

GIM-GGUF-001.title: GGUF not found
GIM-GGUF-001.cause: Configured GGUF path does not exist.
GIM-GGUF-001.fix: gim bootstrap --gguf PATH or fix ~/.gim/config.json gguf field

GIM-GUEST-001.title: Guest container not running
GIM-GUEST-001.cause: Docker guest failed to start or mount workspace.
GIM-GUEST-001.fix: gim doctor; ensure Docker OK; gim start (guest needs engine)

GIM-INDEX-001.title: Code index not built
GIM-INDEX-001.cause: Semantic index never built for this workspace.

GIM-MCP-001.title: MCP server connection failed
GIM-MCP-001.cause: External MCP server in mcp-servers.json failed to start or respond.
GIM-MCP-001.fix: gim mcp doctor; fix command/args in ~/.gim/mcp-servers.json

GIM-API-001.title: Cloud API misconfigured
GIM-API-001.cause: Missing or invalid API key / provider profile.
GIM-API-001.fix: gim bootstrap --api deepseek --api-key sk-... or set env from api-providers.json

GIM-START-001.title: Stack start failed
GIM-START-001.cause: Generic start failure — see detail and logs.
